name: QL
recent: QL Resources 近期公告以雇员公积金局（EPF）及多名董事的持股变动为主，另有董事在闭门期内的交易意向与申报。新闻方面，公司季度业绩持平，成本增幅超过营收增长，并计划开设60家新 FamilyMart 门店。
notable: 董事在闭门期内进行股份交易，包括执行主席 Dr Chia Song Kun 及执行董事 Chia Seong Fatt 等。
公司计划开设60家新的 FamilyMart 门店。
公司预计鸡蛋价格上涨将支撑畜牧业务利润率。
risks: 多名董事在闭门期内申报交易意向及进行股份交易。
雇员公积金局（EPF）近期多次申报持股变动。
季度净利环比下降11.1%，净利率由6.3%降至5.4%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为18.52亿令吉，环比增长2.5%，同比增长7.8%；净利为1.01亿令吉，环比下降11.1%，同比微增0.2%；净利率为5.4%，低于上一季度的6.3%。

recent_en: QL Resources' recent announcements mainly involve changes in shareholdings by the EPF and several directors, along with notices of intention to deal and dealings during the closed period. In the news, the company reported a flat quarter as cost increases outpaced revenue growth, and plans to open 60 new FamilyMart stores.
notable_en: Directors traded shares during the closed period, including Executive Chairman Dr Chia Song Kun and Executive Director Chia Seong Fatt.
The company plans to open 60 new FamilyMart stores.
The company expects higher egg prices to support livestock margins.
risks_en: Several directors declared intentions to trade and conducted share trades during the closed period.
The EPF has made multiple recent notifications of changes in shareholdings.
Quarterly net income fell 11.1% QoQ, with net margin declining from 6.3% to 5.4%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1.852 billion, up 2.5% QoQ and 7.8% YoY; net income was MYR 100.8 million, down 11.1% QoQ and up 0.2% YoY; net margin was 5.4%, lower than 6.3% in the previous quarter.
